findings.consequence: Contradictory endpoint or execution data can become group PASS_SCOPED and warmup admission despite the explicit prior output-identity repair contract.
findings.evidence: The assessment receives case/reference only and checks no header, final_time, method, parallel_layer, threads, instrumented flag or source commit. Direct probes returned PASS_SCOPED for no header/no final_time, final_time=NaN, final_time=-123 with method=wrong/threads=99/parallel_layer=serial/instrumented=true. It also returned PASS_SCOPED with final_state=[1,0], reference_state=[0,0] and claimed all-member maximum difference about 1e-4. The bound compare.py is never invoked by this driver.
findings.minimal_repair: Pass the expected attempt and frozen source/descriptor into assessment. Require exactly one matching header and one result; enforce finite endpoint time against the frozen descriptor, method/size/dimension/layer/thread/instrumentation/source identity and frozen solver settings. Check the emitted first-member state against the admitted vector and require its component difference not to exceed the declared all-member maximum, using a justified unchanged rounding rule. Retain audited Rust all-member maximum as the ensemble witness; do not add U twice or weaken 1e-4/U<=1e-5. Add positive real-shape and negative header/time/identity/state-consistency fixtures.
findings.title: Endpoint and execution identity remain outside the parent acceptance predicate

findings.consequence: The stated 72-attempt/one-warmup/five-timed contract is not enforced and final summary can omit timed failures or fail before invocation TERMINAL.
findings.evidence: Using the supplied synthetic materialized fixture and valid recomputed approval, verify_plan accepted all 12 groups with empty attempt_ids, and separately accepted all 12 groups containing only their warmup while retaining all 72 execution attempts. Empty groups cause receipts[0] IndexError in finally; warmup-only reporting omits all 60 timed outcomes and can report PASS_SCOPED from warmup alone.
findings.minimal_repair: Validate unique attempt/group IDs, exact cases2/3/5 times dopri5/rodas5p-mf/rodas5p-dense/switching, exact six-item ordered membership per group, one warmup followed by timed0..4, complete disjoint coverage of the 72 attempts, consistent metadata and full argv including unchanged tolerances/max_steps/ensemble count. Reject empty, partial, duplicate, missing or mismatched memberships before side effects. Add negative structure tests and a summary test proving one failed timed result prevents group PASS.
findings.title: Selection length checks do not enforce twelve disjoint warmup-plus-five groups

findings.consequence: A malformed output forces independent reconciliation despite a dead child, loses durable attempt cleanup proof and violates complete terminal accounting. The existing tests do not exercise assessment exceptions or a full successful approved execution.
findings.evidence: A real benign Python child emitted a result with finite JSON integer 10**400 in final_state. math.isfinite raised OverflowError. The child group was killed/reaped, raw stdout remained, and controller returned FAILED_CONTROLLER; however runs/<attempt>/TERMINAL.json was absent. COST_EVENTS phases were STARTED(controller), STARTED(child), TERMINAL(controller), with measured controller charge 0.37501684785820544 seconds and an open child reservation of 180 seconds. Child charged_seconds was zero and its elapsed time was attributed to controller remainder.
findings.minimal_repair: Make numeric validation total for all JSON numbers, including integer conversion overflow. Wrap post-child assessment in the terminal-finalization path so exceptions become typed OUTPUT_CONTRACT_FAILURE/CONTROLLER_ASSESSMENT_FAILURE while retaining raw hashes, exit code, elapsed time and dead-group proof. Close the child cost event exactly once only after durable terminal evidence; keep reservation open for genuinely unresolved cleanup/evidence failures. Add end-to-end synthetic success, malformed numeric and injected assessment-exception tests.
findings.title: Assessment exception still bypasses attempt terminal evidence and terminal cost

findings.consequence: The prior requirement to validate driver/helper identity before lock/output/child side effects is not met; ordinary helper changes from another task can run accounting logic before their approved identity is checked.
findings.evidence: The canonical root and executor hash fields are fixed, but execute first opens/acquires the execution lock. execute_locked verifies only the envelope, invokes the imported cost helper, creates output/IDENTITY/START and appends the controller STARTED event; verify_executor is reached later inside verify_plan at line505. A stale approved helper/driver binding is therefore rejected only after unapproved executor code has already changed accounting/output.
findings.minimal_repair: Perform a side-effect-free canonical executor/path/hash preflight before mutable lock/output/accounting operations or cost-helper use. Use a separately defined canonical rejection-accounting path for invalid envelopes/executor identities rather than letting the unverified helper mutate the ledger. Keep pre-attempt and post-attempt identity checks. Add a mismatch test proving no cohort output/attempt reservation/child is created by an unverified executor.
findings.title: Executor hash verification occurs after lock/output/accounting side effects

findings.consequence: Repeated failed setup or expensive terminal ledger validation is omitted from cumulative cost. The claim that all controller work is charged and bounded remains unsupported.
findings.evidence: A synthetic approval SHA mismatch raised ValueError before the guarded accounting section and left COST_EVENTS at zero bytes with no invocation receipt. Lock contention, resume-identity mismatch, event-chain/cap rejection likewise precede the accounting try/finally. For admitted invocations the measured outer_elapsed stops before writing/fsyncing RECEIPT.json, validating/hashing/appending/fsyncing the terminal COST_EVENTS event and output serialization. terminal_accounting_reserve_seconds=20 is recorded but never charged.
findings.minimal_repair: Account every started invocation, including lock/envelope/identity/budget rejections, in a canonical append-only failure receipt/accounting path without starting a cohort. Bound lock acquisition and cleanup. Include terminal commit work with an explicitly charged conservative allowance or separately observed outer wrapper; report measured time and conservative charge separately and avoid double-counting child time. Preserve existing charges/reservations. Test invalid approval, lock/cost/preflight rejection, delayed finalization, resume-only and interrupted cases.
findings.title: Whole-invocation accounting still excludes early rejection and terminal commit work
